Call of a Mad Moon (XIII) is one of the Darkanas in Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by ending a run with a

While Call of a Mad Moon (XIII) is active, a small black bar appears under the timer near the top of the screen, cycling through four different symbols much like a slot machine. These slots are rolled every 7 seconds, granting different effects based on which symbol is rolled.
Four possible effects can be rolled, based on the

stats, each pulsing a translucent aura of their own color and creating an explosion of sprites. The chances for each effect to occur at base are equal. However, the proportion of the player's respective stats affects how commonly an effect will occur. If the same symbol is rolled as the first one with no breaks, the sound effect gets higher in pitch. When four-of-a-kind is rolled, a special effect will happen based on which symbol was rolled, with the fourth pulse being a solid circle of a brighter color and a deep sound effect.

The exact weight of an effect being rolled is equal to its proportion out of Growth+Greed+Luck+Curse. For example, if Growth = +75%, and all stats total to +200%, then Growth's effect will have a 37.5% chance to be rolled with each roll.
The possible effects are as follows:

Experience Gems on the stage once per symbol rolled, increasing their experience value and oftentimes changing their color. This effect is amplified as more Experience Gems are present. Rolling it pulses cyan, and blue and green Experience Gems explode out.
Four of a kind: Blesses all Experience Gems an additional 6 times, for a total of 10 instances of the blessing. An ellipsoid consisting of 24
Skelegems is also summoned around the player.

Coin Bags present on the stage once per symbol rolled, increasing their gold yield. This effect is amplified as more Gold Coins and Coin Bags are present. Rolling it pulses yellow, and Gold Coins explode out.
Four of a kind: Blesses all Coins and Coin Bags an additional 6 times, for a total of 10 instances of the blessing. A group of
Gold Pile are also summoned near the player.

Golden Treasure Chest that grants the player extra weapons, much like those found while playing as

Weapons will not receive the final part of this effect.
Whenever a light source is blessed, if a

If a Coin Bag were to drop, it will have its gold value increased by 5 times per blessing, with each blessing being additive (i.e., 4 blessings will multiply the gold value by 20 rather than 625). Otherwise, for pickups whose weights are affected by Luck, each blessing to the light source will add an extra +50% Luck when multiply the weights of each pickup by Luck.
For example, if the player has no extra Luck,
Rosaries from light sources that have been blessed 4 times will have a base weight of 3 from the effective +200% Luck given by blessings.
: "Blesses" all currently spawned enemies once per symbol rolled, increasing their Movement Speed and Health by +10%. Rolling it pulses purple, and kill count skulls explode out.
Four of a kind: Triggers a
Rosary effect, instantly killing all non-instant kill resistant enemies. A
Blinder is also spawned, chasing the player for 30 s. If the Blinder is killed, it will drop a Treasure Chest. This Treasure Chest has a chance to be a
Dark Treasure Chest, containing a random passive.

Unlike the actual Curse stat, which increases the number of enemies and therefore the amount of experience the player gains, the Curse effect of Call of a Mad Moon is entirely detrimental unless four-of-a-kind is rolled. Since a high Curse stat skews the odds towards Curse slots but does not guarantee a four-of-a-kind, this Darkana may be detrimental in Curse-centric builds.
